newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end slightly higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end slightly higher on short-covering.

text.p: The key June Japanese government bond futures contract ended slightly higher on Wednesday on short-covering by dealers toward the close.
A sharp fall in Tokyo share prices, and comments by Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka which said Japan would maintain its current easy credit policy, pushed up JGBs toward the close, traders said.
"Our policy is to maintain our current interest rate policy for a while without raising interest rates, as the Bank of Japan has made clear," Mitsuzuka said on Wednesday.
He was speaking to a parliamentary committee.
